fullTextEN: Hello everyone, I am Fanfan.
I am a Chinese teacher.
I was born in the northeast of China.
So I am a Northeasterner.
The winter in the northeast is very, very cold.
About minus twenty to thirty degrees.

fullTextZH: 其实在中国的东北一共有三个省
fullTextEN: Actually, there are three provinces in the northeast of China.

fullTextZH: 吉林省辽宁省和黑龙江省
fullTextEN: Jilin Province, Liaoning Province, and Heilongjiang Province.

fullTextZH: 我呢出生在吉林省的一个小山村
fullTextEN: I was born in a small mountain village in Jilin Province.
A very, very small village.
In my hometown,
Everyone speaks dialect.
They don't speak very standard Chinese.

fullTextZH: 中国人把标准的中文叫普通话
fullTextEN: Chinese people call standard Chinese 'Putonghua'.
So in my hometown,

fullTextZH: 大家的普通话不怎么好
fullTextEN: Everyone's Putonghua is not very good.
For example, three, seven, eight.

fullTextZH: 我们会说三个七个八个
fullTextEN: We would say three, seven, eight.
Teacher, we would say 'laosi'.
Eat meat.
We can say eat meat.
Yes, so in my hometown.
Everyone speaks the dialect.
But when I was little.

fullTextZH: 我一点也不知道我的普通话那么差
fullTextEN: I didn't know at all that my Mandarin was so bad.

fullTextZH: 相反我觉得我的普通话特别好
fullTextEN: On the contrary, I thought my Mandarin was very good.

fullTextZH: 因为我参加过很多很多的演讲比赛
fullTextEN: Because I participated in many, many speech contests.

fullTextZH: 那每一次我都是第一名
fullTextEN: And every time I was first place.

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得我的普通话棒棒的
fullTextEN: So I thought my Mandarin was excellent.
Later, when applying for college.
I had to choose a major.
A major is what you want to study.
I think, um.
My Mandarin is so good.

words.gloss: teaching Chinese as a foreign language

fullTextEN: Then I want to study Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language.

fullTextZH: 对外汉语就是教外国人说中文

words.gloss: teaching Chinese as a foreign language

fullTextEN: Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language is teaching foreigners to speak Chinese.
Yes.

fullTextZH: 后来我非常自信的去了大学
fullTextEN: Later, I confidently went to college.
Yes, I am very confident.
Um, because I believe.

fullTextZH: 我一定会是一个非常好的学生
fullTextEN: I will definitely be a very good student.

fullTextZH: 因为我的普通话说的很好
fullTextEN: Because I speak Mandarin very well.
But I don't know why.
When I speak,
my classmates just laugh.
Ha, um.
I don't know why.
Yeah, at that time,

fullTextZH: 我有两个很好很好的朋友
fullTextEN: I had two very good friends.
We all had student numbers.

fullTextZH: 嗯学号就是学生的号码
fullTextEN: Um, a student number is a student's number.

fullTextZH: 每个学生都会有一个号码
fullTextEN: Every student will have a number.
So this number,
is your student number.

fullTextZH: 嗯我记得我的学号是十七号
fullTextEN: Um, I remember my student number was 17.
And those two people,
one was number 20,
the other person was number 23.

fullTextZH: 那每次老师上课点名的时候
fullTextEN: So every time the teacher called roll in class,
I would say 17, 20, 23, right.

fullTextZH: 然后我的同学们就哈哈大笑
fullTextEN: Then my classmates burst into laughter.

fullTextZH: 嗯那个时候我才知道哇
fullTextEN: Hmm, it was then that I realized, wow.

fullTextZH: 原来我是我们班里普通话最差的一个
fullTextEN: It turns out I was the worst at Mandarin in our class.

fullTextZH: 嗯不过我没有觉得很难过
fullTextEN: Hmm, but I didn't feel very sad.

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得我一定会说的很好
fullTextEN: Because I believe I will definitely speak well.
Later, every time they laughed at me,

fullTextZH: 我就会在心里说十遍这个词
fullTextEN: I would say the word ten times in my mind.

fullTextZH: 有一次我和我的好朋友去超市
fullTextEN: Once, my good friend and I went to the supermarket.
I wanted to ask her if she wanted to drink yogurt.
But I ended up saying 'hey'.
Do you want to drink yogurt?
Then she burst into laughter.

fullTextZH: 哦我当时就觉得我又说错了
fullTextEN: Oh, at that moment I felt I had said it wrong again.

fullTextZH: 然后我在心里说了十遍
fullTextEN: Then I said it ten times in my mind.

fullTextZH: 酸奶酸奶酸奶酸奶酸奶酸奶
fullTextEN: Yogurt, yogurt, yogurt, yogurt, yogurt, yogurt.

fullTextZH: 对然后我就记住了酸奶这个词
fullTextEN: Right, then I remembered the word yogurt.
And another time during class,
The teacher asked me to say a tongue twister.

fullTextZH: 他给我的句子是这个四是四十是十
fullTextEN: The sentence he gave me was 'this four is four, ten is ten'.
Fourteen is fourteen.
Forty is forty.
Ah, I think it's too difficult.
I really can't speak.
Then I ended up saying yes, yes, yes.
Ten is ten, fourteen is fourteen.
Facts are facts.
Hmm, you can imagine, right?
I was laughed at by everyone again.

fullTextZH: 然后我又在心里说了十遍
fullTextEN: Then I said it ten times in my mind again.
Right.
When I was in the fourth year of university.

fullTextZH: 我参加了孔子学院志愿者的考试
fullTextEN: I took the Confucius Institute volunteer exam.
If I passed the exam.

fullTextZH: 我就可以去俄罗斯教中文
fullTextEN: I could go to Russia to teach Chinese.
Do you guess I passed?
That year.

fullTextZH: 我们学校一共有三个人通过了考试
fullTextEN: In our school, a total of three people passed the exam.

fullTextZH: 没错我就是那三个中的一个
fullTextEN: That's right, I was one of those three.

fullTextZH: 对那到现在我已经教了10年的中文
fullTextEN: Yes, up to now I have been teaching Chinese for 10 years.

fullTextZH: 你们觉得现在我的普通话怎么样呢
fullTextEN: What do you think of my Mandarin now?
Can you understand what I'm saying?

fullTextZH: 你觉得我有东北口音吗
fullTextEN: Do you think I have a Northeastern accent?

fullTextZH: 你能听懂有口音的中国人说话吗
fullTextEN: Can you understand Chinese people with accents speaking?
Feel free to leave a comment and tell me.
